native_pair_coordination.interpretation: The first pair failed discovery with DNS pending on both. Its serial files began 128.18 seconds apart; the repeat began 80.94 seconds apart and passed unchanged kernel/bundle. Late peer startup is an observed fixture difference, not proof of a general discovery/Raft cause or of historical incident causality. Host coordination bounds listener polling without consuming the QEMU single accept slot; no production guest readiness change.

limits: Host core tests and a finite model reproduce the delayed old-term unsafe commit; native boots do not inject that response ordering.
Peer truthfulness, source identity and fixed membership roles are model inputs; no authenticated networking, Byzantine tolerance or removal/re-admission proof.
The contact proof is current-term response provenance, not lease freshness or linearizable-read proof.
Existing membership finalization and demoted-leader differences remain open in CONFORMANCE.md.
No cleanup owner, recovery registry, physical release or production trust boundary changes.
